records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.live_preview.LivePreviewPanel.regroup_the_folder#1
records.source: The table is grouped when a folder is loaded, with the ``metadata_type`` and ``custom_regex`` the Mask form held at that moment. Loading first and choosing the naming second left every file under one column until something else reloaded the folder. The screen calls this when either setting changes. The folder's file names are read off the GUI thread, and nothing is decoded.
records.context: The table is grouped when a folder is loaded, with the ``metadata_type`` and ``custom_regex`` the Mask form held at that moment. Loading first and choosing the naming second left every file under one column until something else reloaded the folder. The application view calls this when either setting changes. The folder's file names are read off the main GUI execution path, and nothing is decoded.
records.translation: फ़ोल्डर लोड होने पर तालिका समूहित की जाती है, उस ``metadata_type`` और ``custom_regex`` के साथ जो उस क्षण Mask फ़ॉर्म में थे। पहले लोड करने और बाद में नामकरण चुनने से हर फ़ाइल तब तक एक ही कॉलम में रहती थी जब तक कोई और चीज़ फ़ोल्डर को फिर से लोड न करे। जब भी दोनों में से कोई सेटिंग बदलती है, पेज इसे बुलाता है। फ़ोल्डर के फ़ाइल नाम GUI थ्रेड से अलग पढ़े जाते हैं, और कुछ भी डिकोड नहीं किया जाता।

records.source: THE ARITHMETIC IS "OVER", LAYER BY LAYER, FROM THE BOTTOM. The canvas starts black. Each ticked layer, bottom first, is laid on with its opacity ``a``: where it covers, ``out = out * (1 - a) + colour * a``; where it does not, ``out`` is left alone. An image covers every pixel; a mask covers its objects only, so the background of a mask never dims what is under it. The result is rounded to the nearest whole grey level.
records.context: The arithmetic is "OVER", layer by layer, from the bottom. The canvas starts black. Each ticked layer, bottom first, is laid on with its opacity ``a``: where it covers, ``out = out * (1 - a) + colour * a``; where it does not, ``out`` is left alone. An image covers every pixel; a mask covers its objects only, so the background of a mask never dims what is under it. The result is rounded to the nearest whole grey level.
records.translation: अंकगणित "OVER" है, परत-दर-परत, नीचे से। कैनवस काले से शुरू होता है। प्रत्येक चिह्नित परत, नीचे वाली पहले, अपनी अपारदर्शिता ``a`` के साथ रखी जाती है: जहाँ वह ढकती है, ``out = out * (1 - a) + colour * a``; जहाँ नहीं ढकती, ``out`` को अकेला छोड़ दिया जाता है। इमेज हर पिक्सेल को ढकती है; मास्क केवल अपने ऑब्जेक्ट को ढकता है, इसलिए मास्क की पृष्ठभूमि कभी उसके नीचे की चीज़ को धुंधला नहीं करती। परिणाम को निकटतम पूर्ण ग्रे स्तर पर पूर्णांकित किया जाता है।

records.source: The one control the Measure module has no equivalent of. Measure reads a ``merged/`` folder a pipeline already built, and everything about which file is which channel was decided by the plate's naming convention long before Measure saw it. A user who drew masks with a mouse has no naming convention and no pipeline, so the question has to be asked, and this is where it is asked: one row per field, one column per channel and per mask type, and three ways to fill a cell -- drop files on it, click it and browse, or write one regex that fills the whole table at once.
records.context: The one control the Measure module has no equivalent of. Measure reads a ``merged/`` folder a workflow already built, and everything about which file is which image data channel was decided by the laboratory microplate's naming convention long before Measure saw it. A user who drew masks with a mouse has no naming convention and no workflow, so the question has to be asked, and this is where it is asked: one row per microscope field of view, one column per image data channel and per mask type, and three ways to fill a cell -- drop files on it, click it and browse, or write one regex that fills the whole table at once.
records.translation: वह एक नियंत्रण जिसका Measure मॉड्यूल में कोई समकक्ष नहीं है। Measure एक ``merged/`` फ़ोल्डर पढ़ता है जिसे कोई पाइपलाइन पहले ही बना चुकी है, और कौन-सी फ़ाइल कौन-सा चैनल है, यह सब Measure के देखने से बहुत पहले प्लेट की नामकरण परिपाटी से तय हो चुका होता है। जिस उपयोगकर्ता ने माउस से मास्क बनाए हैं उसके पास न कोई नामकरण परिपाटी है न कोई पाइपलाइन, इसलिए प्रश्न पूछना पड़ता है, और वह यहीं पूछा जाता है: प्रति फ़ील्ड एक पंक्ति, प्रति चैनल और प्रति मास्क प्रकार एक कॉलम, और किसी सेल को भरने के तीन तरीके -- उस पर फ़ाइलें छोड़ें, उस पर क्लिक करके ब्राउज़ करें, या एक ऐसा regex लिखें जो पूरी तालिका एक साथ भर दे।

records.source: The Annotate example (``einarolafsson/spacr-example-annotate``) is a real plate: ``measurements/measurements.db`` with its cell, cytoplasm, nucleus and pathogen tables, and the 2,341 crops under ``data/`` it indexes. Every other screen that opens a measurements database can be shown working on the same plate, so this module fetches it once and hands it to whichever screen asked.
records.context: The Annotate example (``einarolafsson/spacr-example-annotate``) is a real plate: ``measurements/measurements.db`` with its cell, cytoplasm, nucleus and pathogen tables, and the 2,341 extracted image regions under ``data/`` it indexes. records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.model_zoo_picker#4
records.source: WHY THE LIST HAS FIVE HEADINGS RATHER THAN A BOOLEAN. It used to be one list with "show unvetted community uploads" beside it -- a control that could fold away exactly one of the catalogue's five origins. With ten models trained here, four stock Cellpose-SAM backbones, bioimage.io's collection, the Cellpose 3 backend's own four and a shared catalogue, a user who wanted the ten and not the rest had no way to say so. :class:`SourceStrip` is the five origins as five clickable names, each one blue when its rows are on screen and muted when they are folded away, remembered between openings. The warning the boolean carried is unchanged and still arrives before the first unvetted row does -- see :meth:`ModelZooPicker._may_show_source`.
records.context: Why the list has five headings rather than a boolean. The warning the boolean carried is unchanged and still arrives before the first unvetted row does -- see :meth:`ModelZooPicker._may_show_source`.

records.source: TWO FORMATS, AND THE PDF IS NOT A PNG WITH A DIFFERENT EXTENSION.
